path_interpolation: continuous piecewise linear interpolation of RK4 nodes
rng: NumPy default_rng with SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3): transported source, independent coefficient source, target reference
coefficient_policy: Compute once at t=0; P is analytic Gaussian expectation, I uses an independent cloud of M points, S uses transported initial particles.
metric: Empirical W2 against the analytic standard Gaussian, with exact quantile-interval integrals
theoretical_status: D and B concern the specified, reproducible interpolated numerical paths. Quadrature checks are numerical diagnostics, not rigorous error enclosures or a computable certificate. Full RK4 nodes can be regenerated from the saved initial particles, coefficients and configuration; saving every node is optional.
